race.comment: RUN WILLY RUN (8) is a first-starter by Gingerbread Man for the Patrick Payne yard. Has shown encouraging signs in his jumpouts and is expected to make his presence felt. Egan's booking adds confidence. LUMINARY MISS (12) wasn't far away when resuming here last time in testing conditions. Is sure to have come on from that and can fight out the finish. WISER (3) made a solid debut at Albury last start when battling on gamely into fifth, only beaten 1.7L. Is sure to have come on from that and get McDougall taking over. Can give this a shake. HE XIANGU (13) strips fitter on the short turnaround and is a likely improver. Could sneak a minor spot.
